name: FLUX1.1 [pro]
description: FLUX1.1 [pro] is Black Forest Labs' fast, reliable text-to-image model. It follows long, detailed prompts closely, renders legible text, and generates custom sizes up to 1440×1440.

examples.name: Detailed Scene, Exact Layout
examples.description: Follows a long prompt closely: three objects in the stated positions, the exact sign text, and a custom 1440×960 size.

input.prompt: A cozy bookshop window at dusk. On the left, a stack of three cobalt-blue books; in the center, an orange tabby cat asleep on a red velvet cushion; on the right, a brass telescope on a wooden stand. A chalkboard sign in the window reads "OPEN UNTIL 9". Warm lamplight inside, rain streaks on the glass, photorealistic.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate.

image_prompt.description: Optional reference image (Flux Redux) as an HTTPS URL, data URI or base64.

width.description: Image width in pixels, 256-1440, a multiple of 32. Defaults to 1024.

height.description: Image height in pixels, 256-1440, a multiple of 32. Defaults to 768.

prompt_upsampling.description: Let the model rewrite the prompt for a more creative result. Defaults to false.

safety_tolerance.description: Moderation level, from 0 (strictest) to 6 (most permissive). Defaults to 2.

output_format.description: Output image format. Defaults to jpeg.
